meta.title: Awesome CTR Scaling
meta.description: Scaling laws and scalable ranking models for industrial recommendation.
meta.scope: We cover papers that (1) study scaling laws for recommendation models, (2) propose scalable Transformer-based architectures for CTR/ranking, (3) address efficiency challenges in scaling up industrial ranking systems, or (4) explore novel paradigms (e.g., sparse scaling, generative pre-training, foundation models) for scalable recommendation.
